files.modifications: Reimplemented the grouped two-column settings geometry on DSH slots, local active-section state, CSS Modules, semantic tokens, and DSH primitives; removed TanStack Router, Tailwind, window transparency, and Cherry component dependencies.
Adapted the provider-list/detail split to DSH's authoritative llm.providers, settings.describe, credentials.describe, and session APIs.
Adapted search, selection, add, configured state, and custom-provider presentation without Cherry Redux or Electron services.
Mapped visible provider and model controls to revision-fenced DSH settings operations, write-only credentials, and draft model discovery.
Separated future-session default selection from current-session selection while retaining DSH as the only model authority.

Preserved the structure-aware break scoring, code-fence guard, window decay, and the verbatim-slice invariant; replaced the tokenx estimator with the local estimateTokenCount and inlined KnowledgeChunkStrategy as ChunkStrategy.

Reimplemented the translate view geometry (toolbar p-3, grid-cols-2 panes, right-cluster toggles) on DSH services; native selects replace Cherry Comboboxes, emerald translate button kept, polling job view replaces Cherry streaming store.
Adapted the list/detail history side panel (star filter, clear all, row hover star, chips, reuse/copy actions) with host starHistory/clearHistory wire methods.
Adapted switches, detection segmented control, custom prompt (persisted via host settings namespace), and custom language CRUD; emoji picker omitted, algorithm/LLM detection stubbed.
Copied catalog ids verbatim; preview images downscaled to 240px webp and embedded as data URIs (plugin route cannot serve static files).
Copied verbatim as upstream source; the runtime previews are the downscaled data-URI versions.
Copied the six upload-format icons verbatim and embedded them as a TS data module for the translate input empty state.
